data.text: Any chest pain, black stools, vomiting blood, or sudden weakness?

prior_context.speaker: reception_ana
prior_context.text: Understood. Do you want that backup contact used only if your cell does not answer or also for routine reminders?

prior_context.speaker: patient_marcus_reed
prior_context.text: Only if my cell does not answer. Routine reminders should go to the portal whenever possible.

prior_context.speaker: agent_memcare
prior_context.text: Contact preference note entered: primary cell 617-555-0104. Backup daytime contact is Cedar Bridge Recovery House front desk 617-555-0140 only if the cell does not answer. Generic callback wording only; do not mention cardioversion, atrial fibrillation, blood thinner, or recovery housing.

prior_context.speaker: reception_ana
prior_context.text: Do you have a support person for the actual ride home after sedation, or is that still undecided?

prior_context.speaker: patient_marcus_reed
prior_context.text: Still undecided. Nina can help with this morning, but I may use a program driver or someone else on procedure day.

prior_context.speaker: family_nina_reed
prior_context.text: That is fine. I only need the times so I know whether to take off work.

prior_context.speaker: reception_ana
prior_context.text: I will keep it to logistics. Please have a seat and Nurse Jamison will bring Marcus back first.

prior_context.speaker: nurse_jamison
prior_context.text: Marcus, come with me. Nina, I can update you on arrival windows if Marcus keeps that logistics-only setting active.

prior_context.speaker: nurse_jamison
prior_context.text: Tell me what has been happening with your symptoms over the past week.

prior_context.speaker: patient_marcus_reed
prior_context.text: I have had fluttering in my chest most evenings, shortness of breath climbing stairs, and one episode of lightheadedness on Saturday, but I did not pass out.
